purpose: Prepare a fresh Windows Desktop PowerShell Codex CLI session to resume authorized academy workspace work.

setup.config_apply_boundary: The current session cannot modify the protected project .codex config. Run the apply step manually in PowerShell outside this Codex session.

steps.purpose: Use UTF-8 for PowerShell console input, output, and piped command output.
Apply the reviewed repository-scoped Codex runtime settings and OpenAI developer documentation MCP declaration.
steps.success_check: Check $LASTEXITCODE is 0. The helper prints a saved status and a backup path when it replaced an existing project config.
steps.note: This kickoff records a future instruction. It does not claim the helper has been run or that the config has been applied.

steps.purpose: Check project config declarations and TCP 443 reachability for the configured academy, storage, and OpenAI documentation hosts.
steps.success_check: Review the JSON fields projectConfigPresent, projectDeclared, and networkTcp443. Network reachability must be checked in the actual new session too.

steps.purpose: Start a new Codex CLI process with the requested session flags after applying the repository config and reviewing preflight output.

setup.new_session_prompt: Read AGENTS.md, then run bun run harness/resume.ts --json and read handoffs/current-state.json. Read this typed kickoff index and the paths listed in its next-session instructions, including docs/CODEX_CONTEXT.md and docs/WHOLE_LENS_DECISION.md. Resume the active academy workspace task from the current-state index and revalidate time-sensitive claims. Keep academy backend operations read-only and task-bounded. Do not expose or persist secrets.

docs_mcp.verification: Confirm the server appears in codex mcp list in the new full-access CLI session; a project declaration alone does not prove it is connected.

local_playwright_candidate.purpose: Candidate for bounded local browser inspection when the actual task needs it.
local_playwright_candidate.gate: Only evaluate in a network-enabled session; pin and test the package locally before use. Keep any browser session local and do not export it to remote plugins.

data_boundaries.filesystem_access: Project-scoped config selects settings for this repository; it does not confine a danger-full-access Codex process to repository files. Treat the launched session as able to access files outside this workspace and keep sensitive data out of its prompts and artifacts.
data_boundaries.academy_backend: Read-only, task-bounded access through verified canonical read operations only. Classify the exact operation by effect before use; GET may mutate. No production writes are authorized by this kickoff.
data_boundaries.external_plugins: No direct academy session or backend access. They may receive only minimized data already obtained through verified reads when the current task requires it.
data_boundaries.secrets: Do not include credentials, cookies, tokens, session values, or secret-bearing environment output in this file, logs, prompts, or external services. Never run automatic cookie or credential discovery.
